```{r}
#| label: els-ancova-interaction
#| include: false

els_var <- c("nar_ndw50_a", "con_ndw50_a")
els_label <- c(
  "Narrative NDW50",
  "Conversation NDW50"
)
els_covariates <- c("nar_totnumut_a", "con_totnumut_a")
names(els_label) = els_var
names(els_covariates) = els_var

# fit ANCOVA models with Treatment*Age Group interaction
els_ancova_intrxn <- lapply(
  els_var,
  function(x) fit_ancova_interaction(
    dataset = data,
    outcome = x,
    outcome_label = els_label[x],
    covariates = els_covariates[x] |> unname(),
    strata_var = strata_var,
    strata_label = strata_label
  )
)
names(els_ancova_intrxn) <- els_label

# extract tables from fit_ancova_interaction output
els_ancova_intrxn_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(els_ancova_intrxn),
    function(x) {
      els_ancova_intrxn[[x]]$tbl
    }
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-els-ancova-interaction
#| tbl-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "ELS - ANCOVA results with Treatment*{strata_label} interaction showing LS means (95% CI)
#|    for baseline and 16-week change, and between-group difference in changes stratified by age group.
#|    {data_caption}")

els_ancova_intrxn_ft <- els_ancova_intrxn_summary |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Outcome = "Outcome",
    strata_label = strata_label,
    n_p = "N",
    baseline_p = "Baseline",
    baseline_p_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_p = "Week 16",
    week16_p_ci = "95% CI",
    p_change = "Change",
    p_change_ci = "95% CI",
    n_m = "N",
    baseline_m = "Baseline",
    baseline_m_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_m = "Week 16",
    week16_m_ci = "95% CI",
    m_change = "Change",
    m_change_ci = "95% CI",
    baseline_contrast_mean = "Baseline Diff",
    baseline_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    contrast_mean = "Change Diff",
    contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    interaction_est = "Interaction Estimate",
    interaction_ci = "95% CI",
    interaction_p = "Interaction p"
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "", "Placebo", "Metformin", "Between-Group Differences", ""),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 7, 7, 4, 3)
  ) |>
  flextable::merge_v(j = c("Outcome", "interaction_est", "interaction_ci", "interaction_p")) |>
  flextable::theme_vanilla() |>
  flextable::align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = 2, align = "center", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(j = 1:2, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  flextable::align(j = c(21, 22, 23), align = "center", part = "body") |>
  flextable::vline(j = c(2, 9, 16), part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

els_ancova_intrxn_ft
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-els-ancova-interaction-forest
#| fig-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "ELS - Forest plot showing Treatment*{strata_label} interaction term. {data_caption_els}")

plot_ancova_interaction_forest(
  obj = els_ancova_intrxn,
  labels = els_label,
  min_mult = 1.1,
  max_mult = 1.1,
  arrow_labs = strata_levels
)
```
